findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111 Insoector observed mice droppings in the following locations. 
1. Under the shelves in the dry storage.
2. Droppings observed on top of the plastic covering of the single service containers and container used for holding plastic bags in the dry storage.
There were pest traps observed but no other signs of rodent presence. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the droppings would be cleaned and they will be on the lookout for any rodent or other pest activities. Ensure that the facility is checked on a regular basis to evaluate and eliminate the presence of any pest. 

(A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: During today’s spot check, the store room is observed to have a large accumulation of mouse droppings on the floor under the dry storage shelving. PIC is having maintenance clean under the shelves today in order to better monitor the pest issue on the 10 day follow-up taking place on March 1, 2024. Ensure that maintenance continues to increase their pest control management in the kitchen, especially the store room.  
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The gasket of the milk cooler in the seating area is observed to have been disconnected from the unit. Ensure repairs are made to reattach the gasket to the milk cooler which will allow the door to seal more effectively and be easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: The hood system is observed to have a lightbulb burnt out in the middle slot. Ensure the lightbulb is replaced to allow for adequate lighting in this area.
6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: Above the freezers the ceiling is observed to be peeling paint. This area needs to have the current paint scraped to create a smooth surface and then repainted/sealed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The carts used to store the red trays is observed to have an accumulation of food/soil debris on its surfaces. The lip of the tray is preventing the food contact surface from contacting the soiled surface. Ensure this cart is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it free of food debris/soil. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The shelving in the dry storage is observed to be held up by bricks on one corner of the shelving. These bricks require a sealant such as paint to make them smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Ensure the brick have a seal placed on them or that the shelving unit is replaced.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The lightbulb in the vent system is observed to have water pooling in the glass casing. Ensure the glass casing is removed, the water emptied, and then repairs are made to prevent the water accumulation. Once water is no longer leaking, if shatter proof bulbs are used, then the glass casings are no longer required.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-202.11  (Pf) Food-Contact surface at equipment including tow pitchers and a ladel are longer smooth and easily cleanable. A food-contact surface that is not smooth and easily cleanable can harbor bacteria that con be transfer to food. Replace with a National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI approved surface. Reference 4-202.11. The pieces of equipment were set aside and will be turned in for new cleanable pieces.
